full_text:
झारखंड में भारी बारिश का अलर्ट, कई जिलों में वज्रपात और तेज हवा की चेतावनी
झारखंड में हो रही बारिश का दृश्य
झारखंड में बारिश का अलर्ट जारी किया गया है. बंगाल की खाड़ी में बने निम्न दबाव के कारण कई जिलों में भारी बारिश और वज्रपात की आशंका है. मौसम विभाग ने लोगों को विशेष सावधानी बरतने की सलाह दी है.
Jharkhand Rain Alert : बंगाल की खाड़ी में बने निम्न दबाव और चक्रवाती हवा के कारण कई हिस्सों में बारिश की चेतावनी दी गयी है. 26 अगस्त को गुमला, सिमडेगा, खूंटी और पश्चिमी सिंहभूम में भारी बारिश हो सकती है. वहीं रांची सहित अन्य जिलों में बादल छाये रहेंगे और कहीं-कहीं छिटपुट बारिश होगी. 27 अगस्त को चतरा, कोडरमा, हजारीबाग, गिरिडीह, बोकारो, रामगढ़, धनबाद और रांची के कुछ हिस्सों में भारी बारिश की संभावना है.
आपके शहर में
रांची में बारिश के साथ वज्रपात का अलर्ट
मौसम विभाग ने 26 से 30 अगस्त तक गरज-चमक के साथ तेज हवा और बारिश को लेकर चेतावनी जारी की है. ऐसे में बारिश के दौरान लोगों को विशेष सावधानी बरतने की जरूरत है और खुले मैदान, पेड़ों के नीचे या बिजली के खंभों के आसपास खड़े होने से बचना चाहिए. वहीं, रांची में आज अधिकतम तापमान करीब 29 डिग्री और न्यूनतम तापमान 23 डिग्री सेल्सियस रहने का अनुमान है. हालांकि, तापमान से ज्यादा आज बादल, बारिश, वज्रपात और मौसम में अचानक होने वाला बदलाव महत्वपूर्ण रहेगा.

इन जिलों में भारी बारिश का येलो अलर्ट
मौसम विज्ञान केंद्र ने इन जिलों में येलो अलर्ट जारी किया है. 28 अगस्त को गुमला, सिमडेगा और पश्चिमी सिंहभूम, जबकि 29 अगस्त को सिमडेगा, पश्चिमी सिंहभूम, सरायकेला-खरसांवा और पूर्वी सिंहभूम में भारी बारिश हो सकती है. अन्य जिलों में बादल छाये रहेंगे. इधर, मंगलवार को सबसे अधिक जमशेदपुर में 5.3 मिमी बारिश दर्ज की गयी, जबकि रांची में 0.7 मिमी बारिश हुई.

full_text:
Heavy rain alert in 15 districts today:Kota-Bharatpur divisions get 3 inches; temperature hits 41°C, hottest August in 2 years
Good rainfall occurred in the eastern part of Rajasthan on Tuesday. Up to 3 inches of rain fell in the areas of Bundi, Kota, Jhalawar, Sawai Madhopur, Dausa, and Tonk, causing ponds, dams, and anicuts to overflow.
In Dholpur, a youth was swept away in a river. Meanwhile, heat and humidity have increased in the western districts of Sri Ganganagar, Bikaner, Hanumangarh, and Churu.
The maximum temperature in Sri Ganganagar was recorded at 41°C, which is the highest temperature for August in the state in the last two years.
Rainfall situation in the state
Major monsoon updates
Youth swept away in Parvati River: During the last 24 hours, the highest rainfall of 70mm was recorded in Taleda, Bundi. Alwar, Chittorgarh, Kota, Sawai Madhopur, Bhilwara, Jhalawar, and Dausa received more than an inch of rain.
Meanwhile, due to heavy rainfall, small water bodies (dams, ponds, anicuts) in many areas of Dausa, Karauli, Bharatpur, and Sawai Madhopur have overflowed. A youth died after being swept away from the Parvati River causeway in Sakwara, Dholpur. The body of the youth, Vijay Singh (32), was recovered by the SDRF and Civil Defense team.
Monsoon to weaken now: Weather experts stated that the monsoon trough line has now shifted further north towards North India. Due to this, rainfall activity in Eastern Rajasthan will start to decrease between 27 August and 2 September.
Weak monsoon conditions are likely to prevail in most parts of the Jodhpur and Bikaner divisions of Western Rajasthan for the coming week.
Hottest in two years: The heat intensified due to a lack of rain and drought conditions in the western districts. On Tuesday, the maximum daytime temperature in Ganganagar was recorded at 41°C.
This is the highest temperature recorded in any district of the state in the month of August in the last 2 years. Apart from Sri Ganganagar, the maximum temperature in Bikaner was recorded at 40°C.
How will the weather be ahead
Weather report of major cities in Rajasthan
Jaipur: It rained intermittently from Tuesday morning until the afternoon. The highest rainfall was recorded in Bassi with 39mm. Due to the rain, waterlogging occurred around Kotputli and Shahpura on the Delhi Highway.
After the rain, the sky remained cloudy throughout the day in Jaipur, causing the temperature to drop by up to 3 degrees. The maximum temperature in Jaipur was recorded at 31°C.
Alwar: Good rainfall occurred in the city and several parts of the district from around 10:30 AM to 12:00 PM on Tuesday. A drop in temperature was also recorded. Approximately 49 mm, or about 2 inches, of rain was recorded in Alwar.
Due to the heavy rain, waterlogging occurred on roads in several places. The Meteorological Department has predicted that the rainy spell will continue for the next three days.
Kota: 42.4 mm of rainfall occurred in the last 24 hours. Due to the light rain, the mercury dropped by 4 degrees. People got relief from heat and humidity.
On Tuesday, the maximum temperature was recorded at 29 degrees and the minimum temperature at 24 °C. The Meteorological Department has issued a yellow alert for rain in the Kota division until August 26.
Ajmer: After a sluggish monsoon for the last week, the weather suddenly changed on Tuesday evening. Heavy rain started, which brought relief from heat and humidity.
The Meteorological Department has issued a yellow alert for heavy rain on Wednesday and Thursday. There is a possibility of rain in the coming days.
Udaipur: There was no rain anywhere in the district on Tuesday. The sky remained cloudy in the morning. After that, the sun came out. By evening, clouds had gathered in the sky once again.
The maximum temperature was recorded at 30.8 degrees and the minimum temperature at 23.6°C. A drop of 1.7 degrees was recorded in the maximum temperature on Tuesday compared to Monday.
Jodhpur: The weather remained hot on Tuesday. The sun shone during the day, and there was humidity. People appeared troubled by this. The maximum temperature was recorded at 36.5 °C, which was 2 degrees above normal.
Meanwhile, the minimum temperature was recorded at 27.0 °C, which was 1.3 degrees above normal. According to the Meteorological Department, there is no possibility of rain for the next few days.
Sikar: Rain occurred on Tuesday after a week and a half. Clouds gathered in Sikar in the afternoon, and it rained at 5 PM. Rain also occurred in areas including Sikar, Laxmangarh, Nechwa, and Dhod.
The maximum temperature in Sikar was recorded at 37.5 degrees, and the minimum temperature was 25.9 degrees. Rain is expected in some areas of Sikar today as well.
